$comment: Single source of truth for the gallery, README tables, e2e tests, capture and library entries. Keep entries in display order.

effects.title: AI Thinking Buddy
effects.summary: A tiny robot that makes agent status readable at a glance: idle, thinking, waiting, success and error, each with its own body language.
effects.summaryZh: 一个会思考、等待、成功和失败的小机器人，用肢体语言把智能体的执行状态变得一眼可读。

effects.title: Orbit Loading Screen
effects.summary: A full loading screen for data-heavy AI and geo apps: a WebGL planet sharpens tile by tile as data arrives, next to a typographic panel with progress, steps and live details.
effects.summaryZh: 面向数据密集型 AI 与遥感应用的完整加载界面：WebGL 星球随数据到达逐块变清晰，旁边的排版面板展示进度、步骤与实时信息。

effects.title: Token Stream Text
effects.summary: Streamed LLM text that writes itself smoothly: bursty chunks are paced adaptively and each word rises out of a blur and dries from the accent color behind a glowing caret.
effects.summaryZh: 让流式 LLM 回答平滑地「落墨」：突发的分块被自适应节奏释放，每个词从模糊中浮起、由强调色褪为正文色，前方有发光的光标。
effects.preview: <ane-token-stream style="width:80%;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:#e4e8f7" rate="36" caret="persist">Flood extent grew by **38%** between the two passes, mostly along the lower Rhine.</ane-token-stream>

effects.title: Satellite Scan Reveal
effects.summary: A push-broom satellite scan reveals the imagery, then a dashed inference sweep lays a land-cover mask over it. Bring your own image and mask, or use the procedural scene.
effects.summaryZh: 推扫式卫星扫描线揭示影像，随后虚线推理扫描把地物分类掩膜叠加上去；可使用自己的影像与掩膜，也可使用程序化生成的场景。

effects.title: Agent Flow Visualizer
effects.summary: A live flow graph of an agent run: plan, parallel tool calls, joins and the answer grow as events arrive, with running edges, durations and expandable results.
effects.summaryZh: 把智能体的执行过程实时画成一张会生长的流程图：规划、并行工具调用、汇合与回答随事件出现，运行中的连线流动，完成后显示耗时，步骤可展开查看结果。

effects.title: Liquid Glass Lens
effects.summary: A liquid-glass lens that refracts the live content it wraps. In read mode it shows an AI reading: it glides along the text, dwells on cited passages and leaves them highlighted.
effects.summaryZh: 折射所包裹的实时内容的液态玻璃透镜；阅读模式下展示 AI 读文档：沿文字逐行滑过，在引用段落处停留并留下高亮。

effects.title: Image Reveal FX
effects.summary: Image generation shown like a real diffusion sampler: noise removed step by step, coarse to fine, out of latent blocks, with a step counter and a before/after compare slider.
effects.summaryZh: 像真实扩散采样器一样展示图像生成：噪声逐步去除、由粗到细、从潜空间色块中浮现，带步数计数与生成前后对比滑块。

effects.title: Aurora Curtain
effects.summary: A realistic northern-lights hero background: curtains with rising rays, drifting folds that lean towards the pointer, twinkling stars and a mountain horizon. Your hero content stays plain HTML.
effects.summaryZh: 写实的北极光首屏背景：带上升光柱的极光帷幕、随风折叠并向指针弯曲、星空闪烁、山脊地平线；首屏内容保持普通 HTML。

effects.title: Decrypt Text
effects.summary: Headlines that decode themselves out of width-matched scramble glyphs: no layout jitter, smooth morphs between strings, a glowing lock flash and CJK-aware scrambling.
effects.summaryZh: 从宽度匹配的乱码中自我解码的标题：整行零抖动，字符串之间平滑变形，锁定时闪光，中日韩字符自动用对应字形乱码。

effects.title: Magnetic Dock
effects.summary: A spring-physics dock for any buttons or links: icons swell and lean towards the pointer, one label glides between them, launches bounce with squash and stretch, and keyboard focus and touch scrubbing magnify too.
effects.summaryZh: 适用于任意按钮或链接的弹簧物理 Dock 栏：图标在指针下放大并向指针倾靠，一个共享标签在图标间滑动，启动时带挤压拉伸的弹跳，键盘焦点和触摸滑动同样会放大。

effects.title: Holographic Tilt Card
effects.summary: A card that tilts towards the pointer on springs, with a procedural holographic foil that shows a rainbow only where the light hits, an iridescent sheen, a moving glare and a shimmering rim. Any content inside; idle sway and optional gyroscope.
effects.summaryZh: 随指针弹簧倾斜的卡片：程序化全息箔纹只在光照处显出彩虹，叠加虹彩光带、跟随的高光和流光描边。卡片内容可放任意 HTML；空闲时轻微摆动，手机上可选陀螺仪。

effects.title: Spotlight Grid
effects.summary: One shared light for a whole wall of cards: it follows the pointer with inertia, lights borders across the gaps, reveals a dot grid and sends a light wave through the wall on click. Idle drift, keyboard focus and touch.
effects.summaryZh: 整面卡片墙共享一束光：带惯性跟随指针，越过间隙照亮相邻卡片的边框，点亮背景点阵，点击时发出一圈光波扫过整面墙。支持空闲游走、键盘聚焦和触屏。

effects.title: ASCII Field
effects.summary: A flowing field of ASCII characters rendered by a fragment shader: brightness picks the glyph, the characters gather into words or images, light up under the pointer and ripple with a shock wave on click.
effects.summaryZh: 由片元着色器渲染的流动 ASCII 字符场：亮度决定字形，字符可以汇聚成文字或图片，指针下变亮，点击发出冲击波。

effects.title: Dither Gradient
effects.summary: A flowing gradient or any image rendered through a limited palette with Bayer or noise dithering (sunset, paper, Game Boy-style greens, mono, CGA-style…), with a lens that shows the smooth colours under the pointer.
effects.summaryZh: 流动的渐变或任意图片，经过限定调色板与 Bayer / 噪声抖动渲染（日落、纸张、掌机绿、黑白、CGA 风……），指针下的透镜显示未抖动的平滑原色。

effects.title: Glass Tabs
effects.summary: A tab bar whose selected tab sits under a liquid-glass lens that really refracts and magnifies the labels beneath it, slides on a spring, stretches with its speed like a drop and can be dragged to scrub between tabs.
effects.summaryZh: 选中标签位于一块液态玻璃透镜之下的标签栏：透镜真实折射并放大下面的图标和文字，按弹簧滑动、按速度像水滴一样拉伸，还可以拖动在标签之间刷选。

effects.title: Hold to Confirm
effects.summary: Press and hold to confirm irreversible actions: a liquid fill with a rippling front, a squish and building glow while held, a drain-back on early release, and a drawn check mark with a burst on completion. Mouse, touch and keyboard.
effects.summaryZh: 用「按住」确认不可撤销的操作：按住时液面带波浪前沿推进、按钮微缩、光晕增强，中途松手液面回流，完成时画出对勾并爆开粒子。支持鼠标、触屏和键盘。
